questions.question: Jesus told a parable about a widow and a judge who did not fear God. What was the parable about?

answers.text: The need to pray at all times and not lose heart
The need to give to the poor and not grow weary
The need to keep watch and not fall asleep

questions.question: In Jesus' parable of the widow and the judge, why did the judge finally give her justice?
In Jesus' parable of the Pharisee and the tax collector at the temple, what did the tax collector pray?

answers.text: God have mercy on me a sinner
God I have done my very best
God I am better than that man

questions.question: In Jesus' parable of the Pharisee and the tax collector, what did the Pharisee thank God for in his prayer?

answers.text: That he is not like other men
